evidenceBoundary: Client event capture and zero exit status do not establish compatibility. Review native server wire transcripts alongside client events. A shell HTTP request or substitute MCP client cannot establish support in Claude, Codex or Cursor.

reviewStatuses.not_run: No reviewed scenario evidence, including a successful transcript capture awaiting review
reviewStatuses.unsupported: Verified client or harness limitation; report the exact missing interface
reviewStatuses.fail: Attempted execution failed or reviewed assertions failed
reviewStatuses.pass: All scenario assertions verified by a reviewer against client and native wire evidence; never inferred by this capture script
